20261119-physics-h2.title: Benda A kanthi massa 3 kg
20261119-physics-h2.goal: Apply principles of Benda A kanthi massa 3 kg to solve the reasoning problem.
20261119-physics-h2.material: Benda A kanthi massa 3 kg lan benda B kanthi massa 2 kg diselehake sesenggolan ing bidang datar tanpa gesekan, banjur sisih A didorong kanthi gaya 20 N arah horizontal. Pira percepatan kaloro benda lan gedhene gaya A nyurung B?
20261119-physics-h2.s.s1.prompt: Benda A kanthi massa 3 kg lan benda B kanthi massa 2 kg diselehake sesenggolan ing bidang datar tanpa gesekan, banjur sisih A didorong kanthi gaya 20 N arah horizontal. Pira percepatan kaloro benda lan gedhene gaya A nyurung B?
20261119-physics-h2.s.s1.explain: Percepatan kabeh yaiku $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Gaya resultan sing nyepetake benda B mung gaya kontak sing A nyurung B, mula $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261119-physics-h2.s.s1.hint.0: Sistem kabeh (A+B): F = (m_A + m_B) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261119-physics-h2.s.s1.hint.1: Gaya resultan sing makarya ing B = gaya A nyurung B = m_B × a

20261119-physics-h3.s.s1.explain: Persamaan gaya sentripetal $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Periode $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, lan nggumunake, iki periode siklotron sing ora gumantung jari-jari orbit utawa kacepetan.
20261119-physics-h3.s.s1.hint.0: Gaya Lorentz dadi gaya sentripetal gerak melingkar: q v B = m v² / r

20261121-physics-h3-1.thinking.0: Ing model Bohr atom hidrogen, endi

20261121-physics-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Miturut hipotesis gelombang materi de Broglie, yen keliling bunder orbit $2\pi r$ padha karo bilangan bulat kali dawa gelombang materi $\lambda$ ($2\pi r = n\lambda$), gelombang tegak kawangun lan njaga orbit elektron sing stabil.

20261121-physics-h3-2.s.s1.explain: Daya urai mikroskop dadi luwih dhuwur yen dawa gelombang sing dienggo luwih cendhak amarga difraksi saya sithik. 20261122-physics-h3-1.title: Jarak horizontal maksimum R proyektil sing
20261122-physics-h3-1.topic: Jarak horizontal maksimum R proyektil sing
20261122-physics-h3-1.goal: Apply principles of Jarak horizontal maksimum R proyektil sing to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h3-1.material: [Mekanika 2 dimensi lanjutan] Jarak horizontal maksimum R proyektil sing ditembakake saka lemah kanthi kacepetan awal v₀ lan sudut θ marang horizontal yaiku R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Yen ora ana hambatan hawa, pira sudut tembak θ supaya jarak horizontal paling dhuwur, lan pira sudut tembak liyane sing duwe jarak horizontal padha karo sudut tembak 30°?
20261122-physics-h3-1.thinking.0: Jarak horizontal maksimum R proyektil sing
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: [Mekanika 2 dimensi lanjutan] Jarak horizontal maksimum R proyektil sing ditembakake saka lemah kanthi kacepetan awal v₀ lan sudut θ marang horizontal yaiku R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Yen ora ana hambatan hawa, pira sudut tembak θ supaya jarak horizontal paling dhuwur, lan pira sudut tembak liyane sing duwe jarak horizontal padha karo sudut tembak 30°?
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Syarat supaya $\sin 2\theta$ maksimum yaiku $2\theta = 90^\circ \implies \theta = 45^\circ$. Uga, amarga $\sin(2 \times 30^\circ) = \sin 60^\circ = \sin 120^\circ = \sin(2 \times 60^\circ)$, jarak tekane padha ing sudut ($60^\circ$) sing jumlahe karo sudut asline dadi $90^\circ$.

20261122-physics-h3-2.material: Apa sifat gelombang sing nemtokake kenapa sinar laser (LASER) ora nyebar adoh kaya lampu pijar utawa srengenge, nanging maju kanthi tipis lan kuwat?
20261122-physics-h3-2.thinking.0: Apa sifat gelombang sing nemtokake kenapa
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.prompt: Apa sifat gelombang sing nemtokake kenapa sinar laser (LASER) ora nyebar adoh kaya lampu pijar utawa srengenge, nanging maju kanthi tipis lan kuwat?
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.explain: Laser yaiku cahya sing digawe liwat emisi terstimulasi, kabeh foton sing dipancarake nduweni dawa gelombang sing cocog banget (monokromatis) lan fase gelombang sing cocog sampurna (koheren), mula nduweni sifat lurus lan fokus sing luar biasa.
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.hint.0: Iki cahya sing diamplifikasi kanthi emisi terstimulasi (Stimulated Emission).
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.o.o0: Koherensi (Coherence) lan monokromatisitas sing apik, yaiku dawa gelombang lan fase ngrambat kabeh foton cocog sampurna
